The '''Communication center''' was a location on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. After the [[Destruction of Despayre]], [[Rianna Saren]] used the comm center to contact [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and inform her about the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] firepower and the Imperial [[Trid|research facility]] on [[Danuta]].
